title: Oren's First Steel
summary: Oren will teach you a blade, if you bring him the makings: iron from the hills, copper from the cuts, coal for the fire. Then you temper it yourself.
ask: Oren: You're holding that like it owes you money. Who sold you that? Don't tell me. I'll only shout.
Oren: You want a blade that lasts? Then you make it. I'm not your mother and I'm not your smith. Yet.
Oren: Bring me the makings and I'll show you once. Once.

steps.text: Bring Oren 6 Raw Iron from the hills
done: Oren: Iron. Good iron, even. Don't let it go to your head. The hills did the work.

steps.text: Bring Oren 6 Raw Copper from the river cuts
done: Oren: Copper for the guard and the rivets. Green already. You carried it through every puddle in the Commons, didn't you.

steps.text: Bring Oren 8 Coal for the fire
done: Oren: Now the fire. Watch the colour, not my face. My face is always like this.
Oren: There. That's a blade. Ugly. Honest. Now it needs a temper, and you're doing it, not me.

steps.text: Temper a blade at a Forge, or with Oren
done: You feel the edge settle. It rings a little longer than it did.
Oren: Hm. Hm. Give it here. ...Fine. It's fine. It's better than fine and I'm not saying it twice.
Oren: Take my mark. Anything you temper, it starts a step ahead. Don't make me regret it. You will. Don't.
